problem:
The following table shows the speed $V(t),$ in miles per hour, at which an airplane flies at certain times since its $2$-hour journey began.

| $t\,(\text{hours})$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $V\,(\text{miles/hour})$ | $150$ | $250$ | $200$ |

Approximate the total distance traveled by the plane using the trapezoidal rule with $2$ trapezoids of equal height.

*Hint: The distance traveled is given by the area under the speed-time graph.*

activity_context.topic_title: Approximating Areas With the Trapezoidal Rule
